title: Write test: COPY callback with active HMAC/ECC devCtx must return WC_HW_E
description: Add white-box tests to crypto2dev_test.c (matching the pattern of test_aes_copy_devctx_guard, wolfssl-qsi.2, wolfssl-qsi.3) to directly exercise the COPY callback with active HMAC and ECC devCtx. These tests use wc_crypto2dev_cb() directly with a synthetic wc_CryptoInfo, so they do not depend on wolfSSL dispatching wc_HmacCopy through CryptoCb. (a) HMAC test: Init+SetKey an Hmac with WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID, call Update (so data buffer is non-NULL), then call wc_crypto2dev_cb with WC_ALGO_TYPE_COPY / WC_ALGO_TYPE_HMAC — expect WC_HW_E. (b) ECC test: Init+import an ECC key so devCtx != NULL, call wc_crypto2dev_cb with WC_ALGO_TYPE_COPY / WC_ALGO_TYPE_PK — expect WC_HW_E. Tests should be gated on WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_COPY && WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_SETKEY. Run BEFORE fixing the guard so they fail red, then fix qsi.2/qsi.3 and run again for green.
